The lack of direct navigation to the Wayback Machine's website and targeting the restaurant's archived pages directly shows a "tool misalignment" or "looping behavior" error. This inaction caused stagnation and ultimately led to the problem not being solved.  

This behavior aligns with the common error pattern outlined in Example 1, where an agent becomes stuck in unproductive loops and fails to alter its methodology or escalate appropriately to make progress.
